title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p6n9: lichen_tdma_init declaration/definition mismatch — header updated, .c body stale
description: link_ctx.c:586 still has old signature lichen_tdma_init(struct lichen_tdma_slot *s). Header at link.h:335 now declares lichen_tdma_init(struct lichen_tdma_ctx *tdma, const struct lichen_link_ctx *ctx). Declaration and definition mismatch = compile error. C body also only inits slot fields (id, assigned, next) not tdma_ctx fields. Must update .c to match new header.
